doomMeter.label: How f*cked are we?
doomMeter.methodology: Mean of publicly stated p(doom) estimates from named AI researchers. Definitions of "doom" vary by speaker (extinction, catastrophic harm, loss of human control). Personal estimates, not formal forecasts — treat as directional.

experts.name: Dario Amodei
experts.context: Anthropic CEO; Axios AI+DC Summit, Sept 2025

experts.name: Geoffrey Hinton
experts.context: Turing Award laureate; The Diary of a CEO podcast, June 2025 — stated '10% to 20% chance' of AI wiping out humanity

experts.name: Yann LeCun
experts.context: AMI Labs executive chairman (departed Meta late 2025); calls existential risk estimates 'complete bullshit'; no numeric update found

articlesOverview: The frontier reasoning tier now spans a 24-point range on GPQA Diamond — Gemini 3.1 Pro (94.3%), Opus 4.7 (94.2%), and GPT-5.5 (93.6%) cluster at the top, while Grok 4.3 posts 90.1% and Llama 4 Maverick trails at 69.8%. On coding, GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7 remain co-leaders at 88.7% and 87.6% SWE-bench Verified; Google answered with Gemini 3.5 Flash (May 2026) targeting agentic tasks, with 3.5 Pro still months away.
